# Pinned Gmsh Python API

`gmsh.py` is the unmodified Gmsh 4.14.0 API wrapper, downloaded with its
`LICENSE.txt` from the `gmsh_4_14_0` tag:

https://github.com/live-clones/gmsh/tree/gmsh_4_14_0

Download evidence: `runs/20260917T215032-cad-wrapper-download-b7d29e67`.
The wrapper uses the existing system `libgmsh.so.4.14`. No system package was
installed. Local package discovery recorded `4.14.0+ds1-1build4`; the runtime
reports `4.14.0-git`. This adapter requires a 4.14.0 runtime and records actual
runtime and API versions plus wrapper and adapter hashes in each preview.
